messages:
sam: FYI CI perf alert on main after merge of PR #4321 — decode p95 jumped from ~65ms to ~120ms on shortseq tests :alarm_clock:
ci-bot: [build/infra/perf] 1744447765 - perf/regression - shortseq-decode - p95 120.3ms (+85%) https://ci.internal/redwood/4321
anya: ugh, saw some customer canaries degrade earlier today. initiating a quick bisect on the merge range now. tagging @jordan @lee
jordan: thanks. initial smoke shows attention kernel choice flipped for many short sequences: attn_v2 (optimized) -> attn_generic (fallback). logs attached:
```
# kernel-selector log snippet
seq_len=8 model=redwood-11b
kernel_choice: attn_v2_prefetch -> attn_generic
reason: heuristic_score(affinity) dropped below threshold
score(attn_v2)=0.31 score(attn_generic)=0.67
batch_flags: fused_ops_enabled=true
```
lee: notable — fused_ops_enabled was toggled in PR 4321 to improve large-batch throughput. didn't expect it to affect kernel affinity for short sequences.
sam: microbench on a repro machine shows GPU kernel time for attention op increased: attn_v2 6.9ms -> attn_generic 13.8ms (per token wall), overall decode p95 from 62ms -> 118ms.
jordan: can we reproduce locally with a small harness? if we can trigger the selector flip easily we'll have a short revert candidate.
anya: repro steps (short):
```
# repro harness
./tools/perf_run --model redwood-11b --seq 8 --batch 1 --prompt 'short test' --seed 42
```
result: median decode 68ms, p95 115ms when fused_ops_enabled=true
lee: wild. digging into selector heuristics — looks like the scoring function multiplies affinity by batcher_heuristic_weight, and fused_ops changed reported microbatch sizes so affinity calc became noisy.
opsbot: note: canary deployment flagged. routing policy switched additional traffic to fallback pools at 09:15 UTC.
sam: bisect update: narrowed to commit c3f9a7 (fused op enable + small batcher telemetry change). disabling fused ops locally -> kernel reverts to attn_v2 and p95 falls back to ~64ms.
jordan: quick patch idea: preserve fused_ops for large batches but add a hard threshold override for seq_len<=16 to prefer attn_v2. cheap short-term fix?
lee: we can push a runtime flag: runtime.knobs.prefer_attn_v2_shortseq = true and set true for canary. low risk. also add logging to measure how often override triggers.
anya: agreed — hold canary, flip flag, re-run perf suite. if stable we ship quick patch, then follow up with proper selector score fix.
ci-bot: queued perf job 1744449999 (shortseq smoke with flag on)
ci-bot: perf job 1744450666 - result: p95 66.1ms (baseline alignment)
sam: wow looks promising. ops — can we keep canary paused until we get a patch out?
opsbot: canary hold in place. will block rollout until manual clear.
jordan: OK i'll draft a small patch to add the thresholded override + unit tests around the scoring math. won't change default behavior unless flag set.
lee: also adding a perf regression test in CI to detect selector-affinity flips: compare kernel-choice distributions pre/post in shortseq smoke.
anya: plan: 1) land temp flag + tests 2) enable on canary 3) monitor 24h 4) root-cause fix for score noise.
sam: thanks team. I'll update the incident tracker and ping CS so they can update affected customers. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: note: related flaky perf alert history: see /perf/alerts/shortseq/ (added to ticket)
